change: 仅将13条注释改为中文；函数、字符串身份、算法、门槛和姿态格均未修改，可逐字反向恢复生成时源文件

commentReplacements.original: Exact finite-state identity evidence. No tolerance, collision exemption, or sampling reduction.
commentReplacements.current: 有限状态的精确恒等证据；不增加容差、碰撞豁免或减少采样。

commentReplacements.original: Explicit little-endian encoding retains every IEEE-754 bit, including signed zero.
commentReplacements.current: 显式小端编码保留每一位IEEE-754数据，包括带符号零。

commentReplacements.original: This is exactly the original audit's effective pose: folded blades ignore submitted spin phase.
commentReplacements.current: 严格沿用原验证器的有效姿态：折叠桨叶忽略输入的自转相位。

commentReplacements.original: Independent reconstruction, numerically identical to the complete original ordered report grids.
commentReplacements.current: 独立重建完整原始报告姿态格，数值和顺序均须完全相同。

commentReplacements.original: Extract only the two array initializers and adjacent grid-building loops; never loads the validator/GLB.
commentReplacements.current: 仅提取两个数组初始化及紧随的姿态构造循环，不执行验证器或读取GLB。

commentReplacements.original: Evaluate this tiny isolated grid fragment only; source has no model loading or triangle work here.
commentReplacements.current: 只执行隔离的短姿态构造片段，不包含模型读取或三角形计算。

commentReplacements.original: Explicitly check the detailPose mapping that supplies all four unfolded blades and defaults.
commentReplacements.current: 显式核对四桨全展开以及默认控制值的detailPose映射。

commentReplacements.original: Requires frozen, successful historical reports. Labels may differ; numeric parameters and order may not.
commentReplacements.current: 要求历史通过报告及输入已冻结；标签可变，数值参数与顺序不得变化。

commentReplacements.original: Raw decoded attributes, exact values, oriented triangle multiset; never quantize or round.
commentReplacements.current: 使用实际解码属性、精确数值和有向三角多重集，不再量化或舍入。

commentReplacements.original: Include normal buffers/versions as well as the original position/index immutability guard.
commentReplacements.current: 在位置和索引不可变断言之外，同时核对法线缓冲区及版本。

commentReplacements.original: Generic injected-audit API is usable in the original checkout and a clean migration.
commentReplacements.current: 通过注入审计对象，原开发树与精简当前工程可共用同一算法。

commentReplacements.original: An explicit expected grid may be synthetic for tests; callers validating acceptance use assertSamePoseGrid.
commentReplacements.current: 解析自测可提供合成姿态格；正式验收调用方必须使用assertSamePoseGrid。

commentReplacements.original: Fail closed on absent old meshes or mismatched grid. Additions are always rerun.
commentReplacements.current: 原有网格缺失或姿态格不匹配即拒绝继承；新增网格始终重跑。
